collection.title: Audi A3 Sportback 2013 to 2020 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit an Audi A3 Sportback 2013 - 2020 which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this A3 which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
